topic: Asking an AI chatbot to help draft a short, clear reply when you're unsure what to say to a text or email
headline: Let AI Draft Your Reply
supporting_text: Paste in the message, ask for a short reply, then edit it to sound like you.
caption:
⚡ TODAY’S 30-SECOND TECH WIN

Ever stare at a text or email, unsure how to respond?

An AI chatbot can help you get unstuck. Just paste in the message you received and ask it to suggest a short, friendly reply.

You can then tweak the wording so it sounds like you, not a robot. This can take the pressure off finding the right words, especially for tricky or sensitive messages.

It's a small step that can make everyday replying feel a little less stressful.

Save this tip for later.
